question:

(II) Resonance effect operates through the pi bond
(III) Inductive effects operate through the pi bond
(IV) Resonance effect operates through the sigma bond
solution:
The correct option is A: (I) and (II).

Inductive effect is the permanent polarization of a bond due to the difference in electronegativity of atoms.

So, it operates through the bond.

Hence, statement (I) is true.

Resonance effect involves the delocalisation of electrons in a conjugated system. This mainly happens through bonds or lone pairs in conjugation with bonds.

So, resonance effect operates through the electron system.

Hence, statement (II) is true.

Now, statements (III) and (IV) are false because:

  • Inductive effect does not operate through bonds.

  • Resonance effect does not operate through bonds.

So, the true statements are:

Correct answer: Option A.
subject: Chemistry
